crew.title: Kelly Caudel answers the emergency line himself.
crew.text: Kelly founded Alliance in 2002 with a simple idea: be the plumber you would send to your own mother's house. Two decades later he is still the one picking up the after-hours phone, and his Texas Master Plumber license number is on every truck.

points.title: Texas Master Plumber #M-36410

points.title: Trained by Kelly personally

points.title: Family owned, neighbor respected
points.text: 24 years in the Bay Area means we know your house, and your house is probably built like your neighbor's.

band.title: Twenty-eight Bay Area cities. Yours is one of them.
band.text: Based in Webster, we cover Clear Lake, League City, Friendswood, Pearland, Pasadena and the rest of southeast Houston. Same crew, same response time, no out-of-area fees.

facts.heading: Family owned since 2002
facts.text: Alliance Plumbing Services has been locally owned in Webster, TX for 24 years, serving the greater Clear Lake and Bay Area. Licensed, bonded, insured and A+ rated by the Better Business Bureau.

facts.heading: License and insurance
facts.text: Owner Kelly Caudel holds Texas Master Plumber License #M-36410, issued by the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners and in good standing. We carry a $2M general liability policy and an active workers' compensation policy, both through State Farm, and every plumber on the team is licensed or working under direct license supervision.

facts.heading: The Alliance Promise
items: Upfront Pricing Guarantee: the flat-rate price is approved before we start, and the number we quote is the number you pay
Licensed Plumber Guarantee: a licensed plumber leads every job, never a trainee left alone
Property Protection Guarantee: drop cloths, shoe covers and a tidy work zone
Cleaner-Than-We-Found-It Guarantee: we leave the space cleaner than we found it, or the visit is on us
Fast Scheduling: same-day availability in most cases
No-Lemon Parts Guarantee: if a part we installed fails within its warranty, we replace it free, parts and labor

facts.heading: VIP Program
facts.text: VIP membership is $14 a month. Members get an annual 65-point inspection with a written report, priority dispatch to the front of the same-day queue, 10% off every service, the standard dispatch fee waived on every visit, early access to member-only seasonal pricing, and protection that transfers to the new owner if they sell the home.

0% APR available on 12-month plans

facts.heading: Free estimates
facts.text: We come out for a free on-site estimate and give you a flat-rate quote in writing before any work begins. We do not price jobs over the phone, because every home and every problem is a little different.

facts.heading: Emergency and after hours
facts.text: For an active leak, no water, a sewage backup or a gas smell, call any time and we move as fast as we can. Calls before noon usually get same-day service. After hours you can book online or use our AI answering agent to get on the schedule, and a licensed plumber follows up.

facts.text: 28 cities across 3 counties, Harris, Galveston and Brazoria, on a service radius of about 25 miles around Webster. Average arrival time is 47 minutes, and there are no out-of-area surcharges.

facts.heading: Referral program
facts.text: Refer someone and when they complete their first paid Alliance service you get a $50 credit toward your next job and they get $50 off theirs. There is no cap on referrals. Send their name and contact details on the referral form or ask your tech to write it down, and we reach out with your name attached.
